entities.summary: Valhalla is a hamlet and census-designated place (CDP) within the town of Mount Pleasant, in Westchester County, New York, United States, in the New York City metropolitan area. As of the 2020 census, Valhalla had a population of 3,213. The hamlet is known for being the home of the primary hospital campus of Westchester Medical Center and New York Medical College as well as the burial place of numerous notable people. Valhalla acquired its distinctive name not from the Kensico Cemetery directly, but through a decision by the local post office to avoid confusion with the existing "Kensico" train station and the newly established Kensico Cemetery.
